item.description: How to judge an appliance error code for DIY: severity versus difficulty, stop signals, security screws and mains voltage, and the cost maths.

item.description: Water hardness sets how often your machine asks to descale. Get it wrong and scale builds silently into error codes. Filters, descaling and fixes.

item.description: A stone from the bean harvest jams the burrs and throws Jura Error 12 or De'Longhi 1454. Why stones get in, the inspection protocol, and damaged burrs.

item.title: Descaling, explained properly
item.description: What limescale does to thermoblocks and valves, why vinegar is wrong for some machines, citric vs lactic acid, and how often to descale by water hardness.

item.title: Samsung oven SE and stuck keys: the membrane fix
item.description: Samsung oven SE code and stuck keys: what the touchpad membrane fault means, how to clean the panel, reseat the ribbon, and when to replace the membrane.

item.title: Samsung oven C-codes: the smart-range temperature family
item.description: Samsung C-21, C-24 and C-F2 explained: overheat shutdown, vent-area rapid rise and cooling-fan feedback on NE and NX ranges, with fixes and costs.

item.title: GE dryer E-codes: thermistors, fuses and the tachometer
item.description: GE dryer E1, E3-E6, E4, E8 and E11 explained: door switch, thermistors, thermal fuse and motor tach, with vintage differences and costs.

item.title: GE dishwasher C-codes: drain, fill and heat faults
item.description: GE dishwasher C-codes C1-C8 cover drain, fill and heat faults, plus 888 and CFE board codes — and the service-menu trick that shows the last error.

item.title: Breville/Sage Oracle steam and ER codes: what to check first
item.description: Steam faults on the Breville/Sage Oracle: what the steam-side Error and ER codes mean, the purge routine to try first, and when scale is the real fault.

item.title: Sage/Breville ER codes: reading the hidden service table
item.description: Sage and Breville espresso machines show ER codes from a service table Breville never published. How ER01-ER18 work and why Oracle numbering differs.

item.title: Miele F77: the valve-initialisation code
item.description: Miele F77 on CM and CVA coffee systems flags an internal fault at valve initialisation. Do the power cycle first; recurring F77 is a service job.
